## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions after its deploy, with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Confirmed the bad release** — v2.3.1 (production, seq 3) was unhealthy; the most recent release healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** in all regions. The first rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error after completing us-east only, so I retried and the rollout completed successfully.
3. **Verified recovery** — all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down from 18% to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api documenting the health check failures, the partial-then-completed rollback, and the recovered state. The on-call engineer has been paged.
